items.text: J.J. McCarthy starts for New York; Jaxson Dart is on IR.

Final report: Giants ruled out LB Tremaine Edmunds (shoulder/chest, reportedly out for the season) and CB Greg Newsome II (concussion); TE Theo Johnson (neck) is doubtful. S Jevon Holland (concussion) is questionable per CBS (Yahoo lists him out); OTs Jermaine Eluemunor and Marcus Mbow, CB Paulson Adebo and S Tyler Nubin are questionable.

Final report: Houston ruled out RB David Montgomery (groin), OT Blake Fisher (thumb) and both safeties Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) and Jalen Pitre (shoulder); WR Tank Dell (knee) is questionable and set to return. C.J. Stroud starts.
